g.text: dot = mean pass rate, whisker = 95% CI over tasks; rows are grouped by model, marker shape = reasoning effort (Qwen3.5 has one setting, thinking on); n = 50 tasks in Case 1, 50 in Case 2, 64 in Case 3

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: 95% CI = bootstrap over tasks (10,000 resamples). Pass rate = share of hidden tests passed. Beam high on Cases 1 and 3 = mean of 3 runs; every other cell = 1 run. Data: results/analysis/model_comparison/summary.json.
